messages:
Ana (CEO): @here Quick heads-up — we're doing a shorter company Circle Sync next Wednesday (11am PT). TL;DR: launch callouts for Dedicated rollout, a short demo of routing improvements, and a brief policy update from Security. Please drop questions below or use the q/a form.
Priya (Product): Agenda looks good. Planning to demo canary routing + cost dashboard — need 10 mins. Can someone from eng bring the latency charts?
Jordan (Eng): I can pull the latency dashboard. Will add a 3-slide appendix with before/after numbers. @Priya which model/traffic slice should I use?
Priya (Product): Use production p95 for inference and the synthetic large-batch test (nightly). Thanks!
Marta (People Ops): Logistics: Zoom link + captioning enabled. We’ll record and post. If you want to speak live please react :hand: so we can order the queue.
Linh (PM): Also flagging a short customer-impact note (support triage) — 2 minutes max. I’ll drop the summary in thread before handoff.
Devon (Security): Quick policy note: we updated the external sharing policy for Private deployments. Expect a 3-min overview and a link to the summary. If you have questions send them to security-questions@redwood.company.
Sam (EngOpsBot): Calendar invite created and sent to all. Event: Circle Sync — Company (11:00 AM PT). Recording enabled. Invite ID: evt_1754449876
Ana (CEO): Agenda (high level):
```
1) Brief exec update (Ana) — 5m
2) Dedicated rollout callouts & customer highlights (Priya) — 8m
3) Routing + latency demo (Jordan) — 10m
4) Security policy update (Devon) — 3m
5) Customer triage note (Linh) — 2m
6) Q&A collection / open floor — 12m
```
Please add follow-up items to the doc linked in the invite.
Priya (Product): If you have a question for the routing demo, pre-submit here: https://forms.redwood.company/routing-demo — will triage live Qs first.
Jordan (Eng): Putting the p95 charts in the shared drive here: https://drive.redwood.company/eng/latency/circle-sync. Will reference them during demo.
Marta (People Ops): Reminder: we’ll keep it under 45 minutes — try to keep spoken updates tight. Childcare stipend questions? DM me.
Ana (CEO): If you'd like a quick one-on-one follow-up after the session about Dedicated (customers/SLA), ping my calendar or @Ana.
--- (AFTER THE MEETING) ---
Sam (EngOpsBot): Recording uploaded: https://recordings.redwood.company/1754449876-circle-sync. Transcript available in the same folder.
Priya (Product): Quick takeaways: Dedicated rollout on track — two customers moved to reserved pools this week (details in product notes). Action: Priya -> send customer onboarding checklist to sales and support by EOD Friday. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Eng): Post-demo notes: routing reduced tail latency by ~18% for the tested slice. Action: Jordan -> open follow-up RFC for kernel selection tuning by next Tuesday.
Devon (Security): Policy summary (link): https://policies.redwood.company/external-sharing-v2. Action: Devon -> run office hours next Thurs 10am PT to walk teams through changes.
Linh (PM): Customer triage follow-up: support ticket #8421 resolved; impact limited to a single region. Action: Linh -> coordinate postmortem with eng and support before Friday.
Marta (People Ops): Thanks everyone for keeping to time. Action: Marta -> send brief survey about meeting length/preferences.
Ana (CEO): Overall: great pace, actionable items, and customers moving forward. Two asks: 1) keep follow-ups tight in the doc, 2) if you raised a question that wasn't answered, ping the thread and tag the owner. :sparkles:
Priya (Product): Filing notes + action tracker here: https://docs.redwood.company/circle-sync/1754449876-actions — please update your items as you complete them.
Jordan (Eng): Noted — will update RFC status and link tests once draft is up.
Marta (People Ops): Survey link: https://survey.redwood.company/circle-sync-quick. Please complete by Friday.
Devon (Security): Office hours RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.company/devon-officehours. See you there.
Ana (CEO): Thanks all. Meeting adjourned. :v:
